name: Canada DLP Policy Pack
description: English/French Canadian DLP identifiers, 13 provincial/territorial health IDs, 13 provisional driver's-licence formats, IRCC, CRA, Quebec tax, banking and contextual PII/PHI. Monitor-only candidate: every rule disabled, severity INFO.
deploy_note: Deploy one channel per run: Web, Endpoint, SaaS, Email. Inspect preflight; no automatic enablement or activation. Review candidate driver formats and checksum limitations before use.
audience: Canadian commercial organizations and public sector agencies
when_to_use: Pilot in disabled monitoring mode to establish Canadian classification coverage before regulated-data enforcement.
notes: Canadian SIN should use the native checksum-validating Zscaler predefined dictionary where tenant exposes it; CA-SIN-Context does NOT validate Luhn.
All provincially issued health ID patterns are format/context only. Some jurisdictions require checksum/lookup validation that cannot be replicated via plain regex.
All 13 provincial/territorial driver formats are provisional patterns adapted from an MIT-licensed open-source source and need independent testing.
CIHI's publication restricts commercial reproduction; only numeric format facts have been used to author original regex, and the original is linked rather than copied.
Policies remain disabled, monitor-only, severity INFO. They should be inspected and tuned before any activation.
Short numeric identifiers are particularly noisy; use jurisdiction-labelled phrases, proximity and customer-specific EDM.
